leftover residual is largest at the temperature extremes, so the temperature dependence is probably not a simple polynomial. Products with eps³ and T²·eps³ helped more than the other terms I tried.

I used 13 of 14 calls and kept the last one unused, since another guess was unlikely to reach 1e-12.

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    L=np.log(eps)
    return p[0]+p[1]*L+p[2]/eps+p[3]*L/eps+p[4]/T+T*(p[5]*eps+p[6]*eps**2+p[7]*L*eps+p[8]*eps**3)+p[9]*T**2*eps**3
